body:
Instrument defect found while running round 10, as recorded:

> - R10-TICK (e), an instrument fix owed in-tree: `audit-find.js`'s intake gather returned all 45 reports from one agent, and the reply was cut off. The first round-10 intake read every seat as missing. It was patched in the lane-B scratch clone to gather per box in parallel; that patch must land on main via a fixer (tools live in the repo).
> - R10-TICK (g): audit-find.js's finder reportSchema lacks finding.schema.json's enums and types (expected_direction enum, numeric load1/thread_factor, cpu_or_wall). 35 of 44 round-10 box findings were rejected at intake on form alone and normalised mechanically (NORMALISE.md on handoff/audit-r10-register). Fix: derive the finder reportSchema from finding.schema.json, so the constraint reaches the finder.
> - R10-TICK (h): audit-verify.js register read, where the agent returned findings as a JSON string. Patched in the laneD scratch clone to parse a string; the patch must land in-tree (the same class as (e): workflow scripts trusting large agent replies).
> - R10-TICK (i): fold_ledger.py must also write audit-find.js CLASS_GUESS (third reader of the class enum).

**Evidence.** (e) the first round-10 intake read every seat as missing; (g) 35 of 44 box findings rejected on form (NORMALISE.md on handoff/audit-r10-register @ d23205d13); (h) patched in the laneD scratch clone; (i) third reader of the class enum.

**Roster group.** `R10-TICK-DRIVERS` in `dev/programme/rosters/wave-r10-groups.json` (lane IN, wave 1, size M, after: none). The group's brief carries the fix shape, the null control and the forward-carried constraints.

**Closing.** The group's pull request names this issue with a closing keyword in prose; the orchestrator verifies it closed after the merge.
